rationale: Description: kneeling with torso draped FORWARD over tube, back arched, arms HANGING DOWN far side with hands touching floor. Currently arms go lateral+up-back (wrong direction), body almost upright (not draped). Fixes: (1) Increase globalTilt +35 → +50 (more face-down tilt for forward draping; combined with spine -30 = net +20° forward, better drape). (2) Reduce shoulder abduction -60/-65 → -20/-20 (arms at sides, not lateral). (3) Flip shoulderFwd +25 → -20 (negative=FORWARD per corrected convention; when globalTilt:+50 face-down, body-forward maps to world DOWN-FORWARD, arms hang down to floor). (4) Reduce L elbow 30→15 (mostly straight arm for floor reach). Kneeling legs preserved (hip flexion 110/108°, knee 130/128°, hipAbduct -10/-10). Spine -30 preserved (back arch per description). Sign conventions verified: shoulderFwd + = BEHIND, - = FORWARD; globalTilt + = PRONE/face-down.
